items.stem: What most directly drives the cost of an OpenAI API call?

options.text: The number of input and output tokens and the model used
options.rationale: Correct: token count and model choice drive cost.

options.text: The time of day the call is made
options.rationale: Time of day does not set token-based cost.

options.text: The number of developers on the team
options.rationale: Team size does not determine per-call cost.

options.text: The colour scheme of the application
options.rationale: UI styling has no bearing on API cost.

items.explanation: Correct: token count and model choice drive cost.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: What is the correct response to receiving a 429 rate-limit error?

options.text: Back off and retry after a delay, ideally with exponential backoff
options.rationale: Correct: backoff eases pressure and respects the limit.

options.text: Retry immediately in a tight loop
Switch to the largest available model
options.rationale: Model size does not resolve a rate-limit error.

items.explanation: Correct: backoff eases pressure and respects the limit.

items.stem: Which TWO techniques reduce API cost without needlessly harming quality? (Select TWO)

options.text: Trim prompts to the context actually needed
options.rationale: Correct: removing unneeded tokens cuts cost.

options.text: Use a smaller, right-sized model for routine tasks
options.rationale: Correct: smaller models suit simpler tasks at lower cost.

options.text: Always use the largest model for every task
options.rationale: Oversized models waste cost on simple tasks.

options.text: Cut context until the output quality collapses
options.rationale: Over-trimming harms quality, defeating the goal.

items.explanation: Correct: removing unneeded tokens cuts cost.
